title: Build a Multi‑Page Blog Structure
description: Create nested routes for a blog section with a listing page and two individual posts, then link them together.
problemStatement:
## Goal Create a simple blog section using nested file‑system routes. ### Requirements 1. Create a folder `pages/blog/`. 2. Inside `blog/`, create `index.js` that renders: - An `

Blog

` - A list of links to two posts: 'First Post' and 'Second Post'. 3. Inside `blog/`, create `first-post.js` and `second-post.js`. Each should: - Render an `

` with the post title. - Include a `` back to `/blog`. 4. On the homepage (`pages/index.js`), add a `` to `/blog`. 5. Ensure all navigation works client‑side (no full reload). ### Verification - Navigate to `/` → see link to Blog. - Click Blog → see list of posts. - Click a post → see its content and a link back to Blog. - All transitions must be instant.
hints: Use `import Link from 'next/link'` in every page that needs links.
The blog post files should be directly inside `blog/`, not in a subfolder.
For the blog index, render a `<ul>` with `<li>` elements containing links.
expectedOutput: A working nested blog with client‑side navigation between Home, Blog list, and two posts.
